output.reason: [ev-80c52188197b] and [ev-927d998f5cdd] both say Istio now resolves conflicts the same way whether or not a `Sidecar` resource is defined. This covers two cases: multiple services with the same hostname, and multiple Gateway API routes for the same service. So behavior-changed is the right change type. The subject name "sidecar-service-resolution" covers only the service case, so I renamed it from the evidence's own words ("Sidecar scoping", "conflict resolution") to cover both. The proposed before/after values are reworded summaries rather than literal values from the text, and they leave out the route case, so I dropped them; before/after are optional for behavior-changed.

correction.statement: Istio 1.24.0 changes how it resolves service conflicts so that the result is the same with or without a Sidecar resource. With multiple services on the same hostname, it now prefers the service in the proxy's namespace, then a Kubernetes Service over a ServiceEntry, then picks arbitrarily. With multiple Gateway API routes for the same service, it prefers the local proxy namespace.
